run_verification: run SDP verification for adversarial robustness on a CNN model with specified dataset and epsilon
verify_cnn_single_dual: verify a CNN using dual SDP optimization with configurable annealing schedule and solver parameters
get_verif_instance: create a verification instance from model weights, input data, labels, and epsilon perturbation bounds
run_fgsm_attack: run FGSM adversarial attack to evaluate model robustness against perturbed inputs
load_dataset_and_weights: load MNIST or CIFAR-10 test dataset and pretrained model weights from pickle file
